headline: Registered Nurse (Enfermeiro/a)
summary: Registered Nurse with an active Cédula Profissional da Ordem dos Enfermeiros and just over two years of clinical experience in a hospital inpatient setting. Experienced in routine ward duties, medication administration, and patient monitoring.

experience.title: Registered Nurse - Inpatient Ward
bullets: Provided daily nursing care to patients admitted to the general inpatient ward.
Prepared and administered prescribed oral and intravenous medications according to medical charts.
Monitored and recorded patient vital signs during shifts and reported changes to the medical team.
Assisted patients with personal hygiene, mobility, and feeding.
Performed routine wound dressings and maintained clinical documentation.
Participated in shift handovers with fellow nursing staff.

experience.title: General Care Nurse
bullets: Administered daily medication to elderly residents.
Performed basic wound care and monitored chronic conditions.
Communicated with family members regarding resident health status.

education.degree: Licenciatura em Enfermagem (Bachelor's Degree in Nursing)
education.institution: Escola Superior de Saúde de Santarém
